name: TREK
short_desc: Plan trips together, from itineraries to travel journals.
author: liketrek
description: TREK is a self-hosted travel planner with real-time collaboration, interactive maps, bookings, budgets, packing lists and travel journals. Plan your trips together and access them on the go with its offline-capable web app.

form_fields.label: Admin email
form_fields.hint: Used to create the admin account on first startup.

form_fields.label: Admin password
form_fields.hint: Used only on first startup. TREK will ask you to change it after signing in.

form_fields.label: Secure cookies
form_fields.hint: Enable when accessing TREK exclusively over HTTPS. Leave disabled for local HTTP access.
